note: One file, two consumers: the Gallery renders its parity strip from it, and tests/FluentJalium.Tests/Gallery/AstraGalleryCatalogTests.cs fails when it stops matching the styles Astra actually ships. Scope is the implicit-style universe - every TargetType a product dictionary restyles without an x:Key - because that is the set an app inherits silently.

parityLegend.audited: Upstream dictionary transcribed key for key with its blob recorded, states mapped, and at least one pixel assertion. Whatever is missing is named in gaps.
parityLegend.ported: Style came from the pre-Astra adapter and consumes Astra tokens, but the upstream key list was never transcribed verbatim and no pixel assertion covers it.
parityLegend.own-type: Jalium has no native type for this control, so an Astra-owned type carries the behavior; adaptation/05 records the demonstrated gap.

upstream's six VisualStateManager groups become ten cells, because markup VisualStateManager throws on this runtime; the open and close transitions and their scale and fade animations are not carried at all

ContentDialogMinWidth, MaxWidth, MinHeight, MaxHeight and the ButtonSpacing GridLength ride as literals in the template because this reader cannot parse those rows, and the control maps the app's own size box onto the card on top of that

a two-button row is two thirds with the spare third at an end, not upstream's two halves, and one button is a third rather than a right-hand half: a template cell cannot write a named ColumnDefinition's Width (measured in both value shapes) and UniformGrid does not reflow when a child collapses

the title's 20 SemiBold rides on a default TitleTemplate, because a FontSize on the title host is dropped on the text element the framework generates; the cost is that a non-string Title needs the app's own template

the title strip and the command row each carry a literal half of the card's 8 DIP arc, because a border on this runtime rounds what it fills and never clips a child - so an app that changes ContentDialog.CornerRadius moves the surface and not the two bands inside it
